g.text: Adaptive verification: survival-scored slots and one global budget (illustrative values)
survival a_{r,j} = product of confidences up to position j (rows: requests, columns: draft positions)
all 20 slots sorted by survival; admit from the left while tau x SPS(B) keeps rising
budget B = 4 bonus + 11 draft = 15 tokens this step
tau = expected accepted tokens = sum of admitted survivals + one bonus per request; SPS(B) = profiled steps per second at B tokens.
Adding a slot raises tau and lowers SPS(B); the walk stops at the first step where the product falls. At high load SPS drops faster, so fewer slots are admitted.
Green slots always form a contiguous prefix per request because survival is non-increasing along a draft.
